title: Calibration of a Density-based Model of Urban Morphogenesis
author: Juste Raimbault
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.repd3dn
materials: LHS exploration of model parameter space.

steps.title: Compute morphological indicators
steps.instruction: Compute morphological indicators on spatial windows using a parallelized R script.

steps.title: Refine parameter boundaries in NetLogo
steps.instruction: Using the NetLogo implementation, refine reasonable parameter boundaries and visually validate both the NetLogo and R implementations.

steps.title: Run first parameter exploration
steps.instruction: Explore 81 points in the parameter space, performing 100 repetitions for each point to obtain convergence properties of the indicators.

steps.title: Compare real and simulated indicators
steps.instruction: Compare real morphological indicators with those produced during the exploration, projecting the results onto a 2‑D principal plane.
